name: Marva Sellers
title: Church Planting Curate
shortBio: Pastoral resident planting DeafChurch First Coast
fullBio:
Marva Sellers joined Christ The King in 2025 to plant DeafChurch First Coast. She is in a 5-year church planting curacy program with the Gulf Atlantic Diocese. 

Marva grew up both in the hearing world and DeafWorld through Indiana School for the Deaf. She attended all forms of Deaf Ministry from Deaf-led Pastors to ministry with interpreted services. She enrolled in Gordon-Conwell Seminary to bring additional reinforcements to her calling to point others to the life-transforming relationship with Jesus Christ. Marva desires for her ministry training to be strengthened with a Biblically sound and theological framework presented in a Deaf-friendly methodology.
